d:
Society members (Babita, Anjali, Komal, and Daya) discover that the Alphonso mango crates delivered by Bhide have completely rotten mangoes. Jethalal, who skipped breakfast expecting fresh aamras puri at the shop, is infuriated upon getting the news from Daya.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
